# Cupid: 5 Days of Love
> Free browser-based visual novel (dating sim) — no download, no install. Play instantly on any device.

## About
Cupid is a web-based romantic visual novel game set in a Korean high school. Follow a 5-day story where your choices shape relationships with unique characters. Fully playable in the browser with no installation required.

## Features
- 100% browser-based — no download or install needed
- Mobile and desktop support
- Multiple story routes and endings
- Beautiful character art and backgrounds
- Save/load system using browser storage
- Free to play

## Supported Languages
- Korean (한국어)
- English
- Japanese (日本語)
- Spanish (Español)
- French (Français)
- German (Deutsch)
- Portuguese (Português)
